knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Air Academy High School (AAHS), home of the Kadets, is located on the United States Air Force Academy (USAFA). We consider all students' diverse interests, backgrounds and needs, and treat each student with dignity and respect. We also utilize a data driven approach to program development and evaluation. Together we foster a strong sense of community building to build a safe learning environment. Our approach to learning helps us lead each student toward success."
